summary: Anda, a schoolgirl, attends a talk by Liza the Organiza, self-styled 'The Lizanator,' a champion gamer and El Presidente of the Clan Fahrenheit. Liza boasts of her gaming records, including 3,522 kills in one battle and over 400,000 pounds in prizes, and urges the girls to play as girls rather than hide their gender in games. She offers probationary Clan Fahrenheit memberships to girls who play as girls, and Anda leaps to her feet in response. The excerpt is part 29 of Book 4.
one_line: Gamer Liza the Organiza, the Lizanator, urges schoolgirls to play games as girls and offers them Clan Fahrenheit memberships.
key_facts: Liza the Organiza calls herself 'the Lizanator, Queen of the Spacelanes, El Presidente of the Clan Fahrenheit.'
The Clan Fahrenheit had chapters in every game and its own island in Anda's game.
Liza says she won the Clan Fahrenheit title through popular election, but members voted her in because of her prowess in combat.
Liza claims to be a world-champion in six different games, from first-person shooters to strategy games.
Liza's battle record is 3,522 kills in a single battle.
Liza has taken home cash prizes from competitions totaling more than 400,000 pounds.
Liza says she games for four to six hours nearly every day.
Liza tells the girls that girls are faster, smarter and better than boys, and that they play harder.
Liza says she started playing at 10, when there were no women in games and you could not even buy a game in some shops.
Liza asks how many girls game, and about half the room raises a hand; when she asks how many play as girls, all the hands go down.
Liza calls the lack of girls playing as girls a tragedy and says gamespace smells like a boy's armpit.
Liza offers probationary Clan Fahrenheit memberships to girls who play as girls, with full membership after six months if they measure up.
Liza wears a black jumper, loose dungarees and steel-toed goth boots, which Anda suspects came from a Camden Town goth shop.
Anda jumps to her feet in response to Liza's invitation at the end of the excerpt.
